message.reasoning_content: Camden PA-24 crash: July 1963? Piper PA-24 Comanche crash killing country singer... Hawkshaw Hawkins? No, that was March 1963 (Pyle, Cline). Camden, TN crash killed Patsy Cline March 5, 1963. "Boys" released with Please Please Me, March 22, 1963. Yes.
